summary: ZFS replace refuses nested replacing/spare leaves and healthy-member false adopts before wipe; pool observation keeps parent markers and ignores class containers; UI hides Replace during scan/being-replaced; size and erase-confirmation checks run before wipe or on wipe-started resume.

guide.reason: Replace disk is absent while the Action cell shows resilvering or being replaced; Needs attention sentences now include already-being-replaced, already-in-pool and undersized.

api.reason: ZFSPoolDevice gains optional parent (replacing|spare). Core refusals for nested replace, healthy-member adopt, undersized replacement and wipe-started erase confirmation are documented. Root-only leaf walk and class-container ignore update the pool observation description.

roadmap.reason: Bug fixes to an existing replace flow; no milestone status change.

state.reason: Observation and refusal behaviour only; durable pool state remains the zpool itself and the existing host replace journal.
